Definition: Kir, a place in Assyrian; also one in Moab
BiblicalUsage: The king of Assyria carries Damascus captive to Kir, and Amos says the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir. Elam bears the quiver and Kir uncovers the shield. One place, named as exile's end.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Kir is named as the end of a road — Damascus carried there, Syria carried there — and God's judgment finds its captives.
